content: अम्बरीषम् [In some senses अम्बरीषः also; ˚षः only by <ls>Uṇ. 4. 29</ls>. क्लीबेम्बरीषं भ्राष्ट्रो ना <ls>Ak.</ls>] .²1 A frying-pan ‘अम्बरीषो भवेद् भ्राष्ट्र’ इति विश्वः . अम्बरीषोपमम् दीप्तं विधूम इव पावकः <ls>Rām. 4. 67. 7</ls>. .²2 Regret, remorse. .²3 War, battle. .²4 One of the hells (<ab>Jaina.</ab>). .²5 A young animal, colt. .²6 The sun. <ls>Rām. 5</ls>. .²7 The hog-plum plant (आम्रातकम्, <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>अंबाडा</ns>) .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of a king of the solar race who was celebrated as a worshipper of Viṣṇu. .²11 <ab>N.</ab> of a Vedic king and seer; <ls>Rv. 1. 100. 17</ls>.
